definition: to say an arranged meeting will not happen
description: In a living room in the evening with dark green walls, a green tiled stove, tall windows and a brass pendant lamp, a young woman with long braids, in pink pyjamas, sits on a rust-coloured velvet sofa under a cream knitted blanket and eats ice cream from a tub with a spoon. Her friend, dressed to go out in a sequined top, a black leather skirt and heels, with a small gold bag, stands beside the sofa, throws her hands out in disbelief and talks to her, then lets her arms drop. A candle burns on the table.

taps.phrase: to dig into her ice cream

taps.target: the woman in the sequined top

en.question: What is the woman in pyjamas doing?

de.answer: Sie macht sich über ihr Eis her.
